apropos.metaDesc: The story of Atelier Lumen, how we work and what matters to us.
apropos.titrePage: A small studio, objects made to last.
apropos.intro: Atelier Lumen grew out of a simple wish: to live with objects that have a story, rather than mass-produced pieces that are quickly forgotten.
apropos.histoire1: It started with a work table, a few tools and a lot of questions. How do you make objects that are beautiful, useful and responsible, without costing a fortune? Our answer: stay small, work close to home and never make more than we need.
apropos.histoire2: That's where the name comes from. “Lumen” is Latin for light, the light that comes through the studio window in the morning, when the first ideas take shape on paper.
apropos.etape1Texte: Every piece starts as a sketch in the studio. We try it at home, and only keep what we want to use every day.
apropos.etape2Texte: Beeswax and soy wax, stoneware, maple, cherry and walnut, linen and wool: natural materials that age well.
apropos.etape3Texte: Everything is handmade in Quebec, in small quantities, to avoid waste and unsold stock.
apropos.citation: “We'd rather make less, but make it better.”

faq.metaDesc: Answers to frequently asked questions about Atelier Lumen products: candles, ceramics, wood, linen and wool.
faq.chapeau: Answers to the questions we hear most often.

questions.r: Yes. Every candle is poured by hand, every stoneware piece is thrown and glazed, every wooden object is sanded and oiled, and the linen is cut and sewn in our studio, in Quebec.

questions.q: Will my piece look exactly like the photo?
questions.r: Almost. Since everything is handmade, the glaze, the wood grain or the weave can vary slightly from one piece to the next. That's what makes each object unique.

questions.q: How long does a candle last?
questions.r: Our jar candles burn for about 40 hours, and each beeswax taper for about 8 hours. The first time you light a jar candle, let it burn for 2 hours until the whole surface melts, and trim the wick to 5 mm before each use.
The mugs, the tumbler and the plate are dishwasher and microwave safe. The vase should be washed by hand.

questions.q: How do I care for wooden objects?
questions.r: Wash them by hand in warm water and dry them right away, never let them soak. Every few weeks, a thin coat of food-grade mineral oil keeps them looking their best.

questions.q: How do I wash linen and wool?
questions.r: Linen can be machine washed in cold water and dried flat or on low heat; it gets softer with every wash. The wool blanket should be hand washed in cold water with a mild soap and dried flat.

livraison.metaDesc: Atelier Lumen shipping, delivery times, fees and return policy.
livraison.chapeau: Everything you need to know before and after your order.

blocs.texte: Orders are prepared within 1 to 2 business days. Then allow 2 to 5 business days in Quebec and 3 to 8 business days elsewhere in Canada.
Shipping is free on orders of $75 or more. Below that, it costs $9 in Quebec and $14 elsewhere in Canada.
Recycled cardboard, kraft paper and no plastic. Fragile pieces are carefully protected so they arrive intact.

You have 30 days after delivery to return an unused item in its original packaging. For hygiene and safety reasons, a candle that has been lit cannot be returned. Refunds are issued within 5 business days of receiving the return.
Email us a photo within 7 days of delivery, and we'll send you a new piece at no cost.
